content.text:
**Finding submitted: deviation (high severity) — Section 6.1 Exclusivity.**

- **What binds us:** Section 6.1 prohibits the Company from participating in any similar internet project for Deerskin Products *or* "products substantially similar" for the entire term, while granting HDI the exclusive "Deerskin" direct-to-consumer web right.
- **Why it fails the fallback:** the term (§4.1) auto-renews annually indefinitely, our only exit carries a Termination Payment (§4.2), and there is no automatic release from exclusivity on HDI performance failure — only the narrow §1.6 launch-failure termination right. Scope also exceeds a defined product category.
- **Redline (validated, fallback level):** narrows the restriction to Deerskin Products, caps it at 12 months from the Effective Date, and terminates the Exclusivity Period automatically, penalty-free, on HDI's launch failure or uncured material non-performance. HDI's brand exclusivity, the §6.2 closeout carve-out, and §6.3 (HDI's reciprocal restriction, which benefits us) are left intact.
